name: WARRIOR
description: Steel and fire. The warrior forges victory from the anvil of battle.
blurb: Tempered in the forge-fires of Emberhold, warriors carry the ancient craft of war into every fight.

name: NECROMANCER
description: Bone and bargain. The necromancer commands what others fear to wake.
blurb: In the ossuary-veils of Palewatch, the dead do not rest — they serve.

name: DRUID
description: Root and renewal. The druid speaks the language of the living earth.
blurb: Deep in the canopies of Mossgrave, druids tend the old growth and awaken the deep roots.

name: TIDECALLER
description: Depth and memory. The tidecaller reads what the tide has buried.
blurb: In the drowned markets of Saltmere, tidecallers barter with the secrets the sea surrenders.

name: DAWNWARD
description: Light and covenant. The dawnward stands as the first line against the dark.
blurb: From the golden halls of Sunspire, dawnwards carry the unbroken light into every shadow.

name: RANGER
description: Shot and silence. The ranger moves unseen between the old trees.
blurb: In the mist-choked lowlands of Greyhollow, rangers walk the paths that exist only between heartbeats.

name: OCCULTIST
description: Whisper and bargain. The occultist speaks what should never be spoken.
blurb: In the candle-lit crypts of Duskchapel, occultists trade in truths that shatter those who hear them.
